mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing pleasant clear skies and 63 degrees around Verona Area High School.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is conducting a study on the US 18 and 151 corridor between Dodgeville and Fitchburg. They will present design updates and gather public feedback during an in-person meeting on November 18th at Mount Horeb High School and a virtual meeting on November 19th.

Local events today include Live Music at Paddy Mac's and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy the Main Street Trick or Treat at Hometown Junction Park and Thursday night events at ART House 360.

In police department updates, officers responded to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue on Sunday, where a 40-year-old Verona man was found passed out behind the wheel and arrested for an O W I first offence.
Culver's is open today until 10 PM, featuring Chocolate Heath Crunch as today's flavor of the day.
